footer.disclaimer_1: KisanSetu is a student-grade educational project. It is NOT a government service, NOT a registered employer, NOT a bank, NOT an insurer and NOT a legal adviser.
footer.disclaimer_2: No liability and no responsibility is accepted for any loss, damage, injury, unpaid wage, crop loss, failed transaction, dispute, delay, data loss or any decision taken using this website, its AI answers, weather alerts, scheme information or job listings.

home.title: Fair farm work
home.headline: A green bridge between farm workers, farm owners and buyers
home.lead: Find nearby farm jobs with protected salaries, run your farm with honest payroll, sell your harvest, and get government schemes — all in your own language, with an AI helper that can talk to you.
home.planet_alt: A glowing green planet with a sprouting seedling
home.features_title: Built to protect everyone on the farm
home.f.protect.title: Worker protection
home.f.protect.body: One-month notice before anyone can be removed, 8-hour days, water, food and rest checks every evening, and safe anonymous reporting.
home.f.wages.title: Salary you can trust
home.f.wages.body: Pay is counted every day from your joining date, never below minimum wage, with 10% extra on holidays and proof of every payment.
home.f.weather.title: Daily weather & disaster watch
home.f.weather.body: AI scans the weather and disasters within 200 km of every farm daily, warns about risky days for crops and checks insurance.
home.f.ai.title: AI helper that speaks
home.f.ai.body: Ask about crops, pests or your salary. Show a plant photo. Speak instead of typing. The AI only suggests — you decide.
home.f.languages.title: Every Indian language
home.f.languages.body: All 22 scheduled languages and more. English and Hindi are written by people; the others are translated by AI, checked automatically and filled in a little more every day. You can listen to every page.
home.f.shop.title: Farm shops
home.f.shop.body: Buy straight from farms with cash on delivery or self-pickup. Ask the AI about any product.
home.f.schemes.title: Government schemes
home.f.schemes.body: Check which schemes you can get and go straight to the official website to apply.
home.f.wellbeing.title: Daily wellbeing check
home.f.wellbeing.body: Every evening workers are asked how their day went. Problems reach the admin quickly — your name is never shared with the owner.
home.f.gstin.title: Verified farms only
home.f.gstin.body: Every farm owner is verified with a GSTIN certificate read by several OCR engines, plus salary and health insurance.
home.r.worker.title: I want farm work
home.r.worker.body: Find jobs within 30 km, get paid fairly and safely.
home.r.owner.title: I own a farm
home.r.owner.body: Hire workers, run payroll, track expenses and open a shop.
home.r.buyer.title: I want to buy
home.r.buyer.body: Fresh produce straight from verified farms.

signup.title: Create your account
signup.s0.title: Choose your language
signup.s0.voice: Touch your language. Everything will be shown and spoken in it.
signup.s1.title: Who are you?
signup.s1.voice: Touch the picture that is you: farm worker, farm owner, or buyer.
signup.role_desc.owner: I own or run a farm
signup.role_desc.buyer: I want to buy farm products
signup.s2.title: Your mobile number
signup.s2.voice: Type your 10-digit mobile number and press Send code. Then type the 6-digit code you receive.
signup.s3.title: About you
signup.s3.voice: Say or type your full name and your date of birth. Workers must be at least 18 years old.
signup.s4.title: Make your secret PIN
signup.s4.voice_pin: Press 6 numbers to make your secret PIN. Do not share it with anyone.
signup.s4.voice_pass: Make a strong password with at least 10 letters and numbers.
signup.s5.title: Share your location
signup.s5.voice: Press the big button and allow location. No GPS, or the place is wrong? Press “Type my address instead”. KisanSetu works only inside India and uses this to find jobs near you.
signup.s6.title: Our promises and your rules
signup.terms.1: Your salary is counted every day from the day you join, and is never below minimum wage.
signup.terms.2: Nobody can remove you from a job without one month's notice.
signup.terms.3: Work is at most 8 hours a day, with water, food and rest breaks.
signup.terms.4: Every evening you can say how your day went. Your name is never shown to the farm owner.
signup.terms.5: Do not send false reports. Repeated false reports lead to a warning and then a ban.
signup.terms.6: Your data is encrypted. If you delete your account it is kept for 30 days and a copy is sent to you.

terms.boiler.11: Protective gear is provided for pesticides, machines and other risky work.
terms.boiler.12: Men and women get equal pay for equal work. No discrimination by caste, religion, gender or origin.

legal.terms.farm_boiler: Standard fair terms between farms and workers
legal.terms.1: KisanSetu is a student-grade educational project that connects farm workers, farm owners and buyers in India. Use is at your own risk.
legal.terms.2: You must be inside India, at least 18 years old to work or own a farm, and give true information.
legal.terms.3: Farm owners must verify a valid GSTIN and keep salary insurance and health insurance valid at all times.
legal.terms.4: Salaries are counted every day from joining, never below minimum wage, and must be paid in full by the billing date set by the admin. Overdue salaries halt the farm's operations.
legal.terms.5: No one may be removed from a job without one month's notice. A farm or branch can close only after all salaries and orders are settled.
legal.terms.6: Work is limited to 8 hours a day. Working on a holiday earns 10% extra for every worker that day.
legal.terms.7: Workers' reports are confidential. Owners receive only anonymous warnings. Several reports can halt a branch for safety; owners may be ordered to pay compensation.
legal.terms.8: False reports lead to warnings and then a ban. Only the super admin can lift a ban, after an appeal.
legal.terms.9: Every change is shown as a summary first and happens only after you press GO. Co-owners must approve important farm decisions together.
legal.terms.10: The shop accepts only cash on delivery or self-pickup. Buyers pay the courier charge. Every order and stock change is time-stamped to prevent duplicates.
legal.terms.11: The AI helper may be wrong and can only suggest actions. It cannot run programs or change anything by itself.
legal.terms.12: Jobs from other websites are governed by those websites' policies. These terms do not apply to them.
legal.terms.13: Abuse, spam, fraud, attacks or automated misuse lead to IP blocks and account bans.
legal.terms.14: No liability: KisanSetu accepts no responsibility for any loss, damage, dispute or decision arising from use of the platform.
legal.privacy.1: We collect your name, mobile number, location, photo and the details you choose to add. Email is required only for farm owners.
legal.privacy.2: Your location is used only to check that you are in India, to find jobs within 30 km and for weather alerts.
legal.privacy.3: ID proof is optional. ID numbers and documents are encrypted with AES-256 and only you can see them.
legal.privacy.4: Passwords are protected with Argon2id and a secret pepper. We never see your PIN.
legal.privacy.5: Your photo is visible to other users. Your phone and email are visible to logged-in farmers only if you allow it.
legal.privacy.6: Workers' wellbeing answers and reports go to the platform admin only. They are never shown to the farm owner with your name.
legal.privacy.7: AI questions are processed by our AI providers to answer you. Do not share passwords or codes with the AI.
legal.privacy.8: Salary, payment, purchase and ledger records are kept for accounting even after account deletion, with your name.
legal.privacy.9: When you delete your account, your data is kept for 30 days and a copy is sent to you; then your personal details are erased.
legal.privacy.10: You can download your statement, correct your details, and ask for your data at any time.
legal.privacy.11: Sessions are stored securely on the server. Cookies are used only to keep you logged in, protect against attacks and remember your language and theme.
legal.privacy.12: For privacy questions or complaints, contact the platform admin through the security contact listed in the footer.
legal.disclaimer.1: KisanSetu is a student-grade project made for learning. It is not a government service.
legal.disclaimer.2: No liability and no responsibility is accepted for any loss of money, crops, wages, property, data, health or life.
legal.disclaimer.3: AI answers, crop advice, pest and disease identification can be wrong. Consult your local Krishi Vigyan Kendra or agriculture officer.
legal.disclaimer.4: Weather and disaster alerts come from public data and may be late or wrong. Always follow IMD and local authorities.
legal.disclaimer.5: Minimum wages, tax slabs and scheme rules are set by the admin and may be out of date. Check official notifications.
legal.disclaimer.6: OCR may misread documents and screenshots. Keep your own payment records.
legal.disclaimer.7: Farms, buyers and workers are responsible for their own agreements, payments and conduct.
legal.disclaimer.8: Jobs from other websites are not checked by KisanSetu and are governed by those websites.
legal.disclaimer.9: By using KisanSetu you accept these limits.
legal.accessibility.1: Every page can be read aloud in your language with the Listen buttons.
legal.accessibility.2: You can speak instead of typing wherever you see the microphone.
legal.accessibility.3: Big buttons, pictures and simple steps help people who cannot read well.
legal.accessibility.4: The site works with keyboards and screen readers and respects reduced-motion settings.
legal.accessibility.5: Light and dark themes are available. Right-to-left languages are supported.

guide.lang.title: Your language
guide.lang.text: Choose your language here. Everything, including my voice, changes to it.
guide.signup.title: Join
guide.signup.text: New here? Tap Join. You need your mobile number; a code will come by SMS.
guide.login.title: Sign in
guide.login.text: Already joined? Tap Sign in and enter your mobile number and PIN.
guide.my-job.title: Your job
guide.my-job.text: This box is your job: the farm, your work place, your pay per day or month, and your work hours.
guide.pay-stats.title: Your money
guide.pay-stats.text: Earned is all your pay so far. Paid is what you already got. Unpaid is what the farm still owes you. Overdue means that money is late — you can report it.
guide.contacts.title: Who to call
guide.contacts.text: These are the farm owner and managers. Tap the number to call, or WhatsApp to send a message.
guide.report.title: Report a problem
guide.report.text: No water, no pay, bad treatment? Tap here. Your name is kept secret from the farm.
guide.statement.title: Pay record
guide.statement.text: Download a list of every day you worked and every payment, to keep as proof.
guide.resign.title: Leave this job
guide.resign.text: Only if you want to stop working here. The farm must still pay all money owed to you.
guide.job-search.title: Find work
guide.job-search.text: Type the work you want, or tap the microphone and say it. You can also choose a town.
guide.jobs-near.title: Jobs near me
guide.jobs-near.text: Tap to see jobs close to where you are now. Jobs are offered only within 30 km.
guide.job-list.title: Jobs
guide.job-list.text: Each card is one job with its pay and distance. Tap a card to see details and apply.
guide.job-rights.title: Your rights
guide.job-rights.text: These rights are always yours on KisanSetu, whatever the farm says.
guide.terms.title: Farm rules
guide.terms.text: These are the farm's rules for this job. Read or listen before you agree.
guide.terms-explain.title: Explain simply
guide.terms-explain.text: Tap this and I will explain the rules in easy words, and warn you about anything risky.
guide.terms-accept.title: Agree to the rules
guide.terms-accept.text: Tick this box only if you understood and agree with the rules.
guide.job-apply.title: Apply
guide.job-apply.text: Tap to ask for this job. The farm will see your request and reply.
guide.scheme-form.title: Check government schemes
guide.scheme-form.text: Answer a few questions about yourself. Nothing is saved. Then tap the big button.
guide.scheme-results.title: Schemes for you
guide.scheme-results.text: These schemes may suit you. Tap Official site to apply on the government website.
guide.report-what.title: What happened?
guide.report-what.text: Tap every problem that is true, for example no water or salary not paid.
guide.report-voice.title: Tell in your words
guide.report-voice.text: You can write more here, or tap the microphone and speak. This is optional.
guide.report-send.title: Send the report
guide.report-send.text: Tap to send. The farm never learns who reported.
guide.signup-role.title: Who are you?
guide.signup-role.text: Choose farm worker if you want work, farm owner if you hire people, buyer if you only shop.
guide.signup-phone.title: Mobile number
guide.signup-phone.text: Type your 10-digit mobile number. A secret code will come by SMS.
guide.signup-otp.title: SMS code
guide.signup-otp.text: Type the code from the SMS here. Never tell this code to anyone, even if they say they are from KisanSetu.
guide.signup-pin.title: Your PIN
guide.signup-pin.text: Make a secret number to sign in. Do not use 123456 or your birth year.
guide.login-phone.title: Mobile number
guide.login-phone.text: Type the mobile number you joined with.
guide.login-pin.title: PIN
guide.login-pin.text: Type your secret PIN. If you forgot it, tap Forgot PIN.
guide.account-lang.title: Language
guide.account-lang.text: Change the app language here at any time.
guide.shop-search.title: Search the shop
guide.shop-search.text: Type or say what you want to buy, like rice, seeds or milk.
guide.shop-cart.title: Your basket
guide.shop-cart.text: Things you chose are kept here until you order.
guide.nav.title: Main buttons
guide.nav.text: These buttons at the bottom take you home, to jobs, to the shop, to help, and to your account.
guide.ai-help.title: Ask Kisan Mitra
guide.ai-help.text: Tap here to ask anything in your language, by typing or speaking. I can also point things out on the screen.
guide.give-notice.title: Give notice
guide.give-notice.text: Ends a person's job after a 30-day notice; they are paid until the last day. You can only do this for people below your role.
guide.change-role.title: Change role
guide.change-role.text: Promote or change someone's role. The owner and all co-owners must agree.
gloss.tds.simple: A small part of your pay kept back as income tax and paid to the government in your name. If your yearly income is low, you can get it back.
gloss.notice.simple: Time given before a job ends. Here the farm must tell you 30 days before, and pay you until the last day.
gloss.min_wage.simple: The lowest pay allowed by law in your state. Nobody may pay you less.
gloss.due.simple: Money the farm still has to pay you.
gloss.overdue.simple: Pay that should already have been given but was not. You can report it.
gloss.gross.simple: Your full pay before anything is cut.
gloss.net.simple: What you really get after tax is cut.
gloss.advance.simple: Money given before the work is done. Nobody may force you to keep working to repay it — that is bonded labour and it is illegal.
gloss.deduction.simple: Money cut from your pay. On KisanSetu only tax (TDS) may be cut.
gloss.holiday_premium.simple: Extra pay for working on a holiday or weekly off. Working that day is your choice.
gloss.co_owner.simple: A partner who shares the big decisions of the farm with the owner.
gloss.proposal.simple: A change that waits until the owner and every co-owner say yes.
gloss.grievance.simple: A report about a problem at work. Your name is never shown to the farm.
gloss.premium.simple: The money paid to keep an insurance running.
gloss.sum_insured.simple: The most money the insurance will pay after a loss.
gloss.claim.simple: Asking the insurance company for money after a loss.
gloss.kyc.simple: Proving who you are, usually with Aadhaar and an OTP.
gloss.otp.simple: A one-time secret number sent by SMS. Never tell it to anyone.
gloss.upi.simple: Sending money from a phone, for example with PhonePe, Google Pay, Paytm or BHIM.
gloss.ifsc.simple: The code of your bank branch. It is printed in your passbook.
gloss.epf.simple: Savings for old age: part of your salary is kept and your employer adds more.
gloss.esic.simple: Government health insurance for workers and their families.
gloss.pension.simple: Money paid every month in old age.
gloss.subsidy.simple: Government help that pays part of the cost for you.
gloss.eligible.simple: Allowed to apply because you match the rules.
gloss.instalment.simple: One part of a payment that comes in pieces.
gloss.arbitration.simple: Settling a fight through a chosen person instead of a court. It can make it harder for you to complain.
gloss.liability.simple: Being the one who must pay for a loss.
gloss.probation.simple: A trial time at the start of a job. You must be paid for it.
gloss.termination.simple: Ending your job. On KisanSetu it needs a 30-day notice.
gloss.bonded.simple: Being forced to work to repay a loan. It is illegal in India. Report it at once.
gloss.hectare.simple: A size of land: about 2.5 acres.
terms.simple.1: You get at least the legal minimum pay for every day, from the day you join.
terms.simple.2: Your full salary comes every month by the billing date, with proof of payment.
terms.simple.3: You work at most {hours} hours a day, with rest and meal breaks.
terms.simple.4: Drinking water, shade and a place to rest are always there.
terms.simple.5: Working on a holiday is your choice and pays {pct}% extra.
terms.simple.6: The farm must tell you {days} days before ending your job, and pay you until the last day. You may leave any time.
terms.simple.7: No fines and no cuts from your pay, except tax. Nobody keeps your Aadhaar or ID.
terms.simple.8: You can report any problem through KisanSetu. Your name stays secret and no one may punish you.
terms.risk.deposit.title: Asks you to pay a deposit
terms.risk.deposit.why: You may never get this money back. A farm should not take money from workers to give them a job.
terms.risk.advance_loan.title: Loan or advance repaid by working
terms.risk.advance_loan.why: Working to repay a loan can trap you. Forcing someone to work off a debt is bonded labour, which is illegal.
terms.risk.wage_held.title: Pay held back for a long time
terms.risk.wage_held.why: If pay comes only at the end of the season, you may never get it. By law wages must be paid at least every month.
terms.risk.unpaid_trial.title: Unpaid trial period
terms.risk.unpaid_trial.why: Every day of work must be paid, even training or trial days.
terms.risk.penalty_leaving.title: You lose money if you leave
terms.risk.penalty_leaving.why: You are free to leave a job. Money you already earned must be paid.
terms.risk.documents.title: Asks for your documents
terms.risk.documents.why: Never hand over original Aadhaar, passbook or ATM card. A copy shown to verify is enough.
terms.risk.deductions.title: Money cut for food, room or tools
terms.risk.deductions.why: Check how much is cut and that the rest is still more than the minimum wage.
terms.risk.damage.title: You pay for damage or loss
terms.risk.damage.why: Accidents happen. Paying for broken tools or lost crops can eat your whole salary.
terms.risk.long_hours.title: Very long or unclear hours
terms.risk.long_hours.why: On KisanSetu work is at most 8 hours a day. Extra work must be your choice and paid extra.
terms.risk.no_leave.title: No days off
terms.risk.no_leave.why: Everyone needs a weekly day of rest. Working every day can harm your health.
terms.risk.dismiss_anytime.title: Says you can be removed any time
terms.risk.dismiss_anytime.why: On KisanSetu the farm must still give 30 days' notice and pay until the last day.
terms.risk.worker_long_notice.title: You must give a long notice
terms.risk.worker_long_notice.why: This can keep you stuck in a job you want to leave. On KisanSetu you may leave any time.
terms.risk.paid_in_kind.title: Paid in grain or crops
terms.risk.paid_in_kind.why: Wages must be paid in money. Grain can be worth less than promised.
terms.risk.non_compete.title: Cannot work at other farms
terms.risk.non_compete.why: This may stop you from finding work nearby after you leave.
terms.risk.rights_waiver.title: Limits your right to complain
terms.risk.rights_waiver.why: You can always report problems through KisanSetu, and go to the labour office or court.
terms.risk.travel_cost.title: Travel at your own cost
terms.risk.travel_cost.why: Count this cost: it lowers what you really earn.
terms.risk.output_pay.title: Pay depends on output
terms.risk.output_pay.why: Bad weather can lower your pay. You must still get at least the minimum wage.
terms.risk.photos_data.title: Your photos or details may be shared
terms.risk.photos_data.why: Ask how they will be used. You can say no.
terms.risk.unpaid_work.title: Work without pay
terms.risk.unpaid_work.why: This may be illegal. Every day of work must be paid at least the minimum wage.
terms.risk.wage_withholding.title: Pay can be forfeited or withheld
terms.risk.wage_withholding.why: This may be illegal. Earned wages belong to you.
terms.risk.excess_hours.title: More than 8 hours a day
terms.risk.excess_hours.why: This may break the law and KisanSetu's 8-hour limit.
terms.risk.no_notice.title: Job can end without notice

terms.risk.id_retention.title: Keeps your ID documents

stress.title: Stress test results
stress.lead: How KisanSetu holds up when hundreds of farm workers, owners and buyers use it at the same time. Each run is a Locust load test against the real app running several server processes; afterwards the database is checked for mistakes such as double payments or overselling.
stress.none: No stress test has been run yet.
stress.checks_help: After every run the database is checked. Each line must hold no matter how hard the test pushed.
stress.how.1: Simulated people sign in, search for jobs, apply, get paid, order from farm shops, ask the AI and switch devices — like real use, only many at once.
stress.how.2: Attackers are simulated too: password guessing, spam, malware uploads and forged requests. They must be stopped without blocking real people.
stress.how.3: Every request is timed; p95 means 95 out of 100 requests were at least this fast.
stress.how.4: Anything that goes wrong is fixed, and the test is run again.
stress.findings: {n} problems found by these tests have been fixed.
stress.private_note: Technical details (individual requests, error messages, server internals) are shown only to the administrators.
home.stress.title: Tested under heavy load
home.stress.body: We simulate hundreds of people using KisanSetu at once and check that no salary, order or account goes wrong.

home.f.location.title: No GPS? No problem
home.f.location.body: Type your village, district and state instead of sharing GPS. Joining farms and deliveries use the location you gave.

home.f.camera.body: Photograph yourself, your documents, receipts or a sick plant with the camera right on the page — on a phone or a laptop.
home.f.grow.title: From worker to owner
home.f.grow.body: A farm worker can become a farm owner too, without losing the job they have.
terms.rule.fee_from_worker: Workers must never pay to get, keep or leave a job (fees, deposits, bonds) — this is how debt bondage starts.
terms.rule.id_retention: A farm may never keep a worker's Aadhaar, ID card, passbook or other documents.
terms.rule.bonded_labour: Making people work off an advance or a debt is bonded labour, which is a crime.
terms.rule.unpaid_work: Work must always be paid — at least the minimum wage.
terms.rule.wage_withholding: Earned wages can never be withheld or forfeited.
terms.rule.excess_hours: A working day may not be longer than 8 hours on KisanSetu.
terms.rule.no_notice: Nobody can be removed without one month's notice.
terms.rule.child_labour: Children must never be made to work.
terms.rule.fines: Fines and penalties cut wages unlawfully.
terms.rule.denial_of_essentials: Drinking water, food breaks and rest must always be provided.
terms.rule.rights_waiver: Workers can never give up their right to complain or to claim.
terms.rule.discrimination: Pay and treatment must be equal regardless of gender, caste or religion.

terms.risk.pay_to_join.why: A farm must never take money from you to give you work. Do not pay — you may never get it back, and it can trap you in debt. Report this farm.
